▪︎≥18yo · measurable neuro deficit - treat ASAP (time-dependent benefit)
▪︎exclusion: ischemic CVA w.in 3mo · GI bleed w.in 21d
▪︎warnings (⍉exclusion): age >75yo (FDA label) · remote GI bleed >21d · glucose <50 or >400 → correct & reexamine
large-vessel occlusion: endovascular thrombectomy w.in 6hrs (CTA/MRA confirms occlusion) · up to 24hrs in selected pts (DAWN/DEFUSE 3 risk-stratify) - tPA trial 1st if
≥185/110 (tPA candidate) - ⍉tPA: tx only if >220/120 or another condition benefits from BP control
▪︎IV labetalol · nicardipine (reversible, titratable) - nitroprusside 2nd-line (↑ICP · platelet effects)
▪︎DAPT (clopidogrel + ASA) started w.in 24hrs for high-risk TIA or minor CVA - ticagrelor reasonable alt to clopidogrel
Sickle cell dz + acute ischemic CVA → transfusion therapy
